method.intersection: Actual OBJ triangles intersected with y=constant planes; edge crossing endpoints joined by quantized 3D coordinates; deduplicated undirected segments form degree-2 closed loops. Polygon perimeter sums only selected loop edge lengths.

depth.content: Existing synthetic side proxy preview; not an inferred depth map.

dimensions.definition: Assumed scale height, not measured human stature
limitations: Synthetic simplified body proxy; no anatomical accuracy established.
